secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI Chat feature (optional — app boots without it). Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

secrets.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional custom base URL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Azure, Ollama). Defaults to OpenAI's official endpoint.

secrets.name: OPENAI_MODEL
secrets.description: Model name for the AI Chat feature (optional). Defaults to gpt-4o-mini.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email (OTP verification, password reset). Optional — app boots without it. Get it from https://resend.com/api-keys
